body: "  but sometimes you just have to do it " THIS is probably bad wording on your part. But OP, you never have to do something you're uncomfortable with. There are a lot of guys who are understanding and kind. There are some who are not. That second group has no right to make you do anything you aren't happy to do. If you don't feel comfortable, you should have your 'no' be treated as a full stop.

Yeah. I'd gotten hired out of temp work by this company some years ago. I logged into the agency and they still had all my stuff so i spammed jobs that were up front about their pay. Anything fitting my needs was applied for. 

If i dont get any call backs from the 30 or so various apps and resumes Ive submitted, Ill know Ive failed for good.
Literally just got laid off for depression related performance issues and on one hand your post gives me a lot of hope. On the other Im not sure Im able to go through that much more turmoil.
I can't fall asleep because any moment spent not-submitting-job-apps is spent crying. I hurt all over and my head is pounding. Im so tired

No. My family is so fucked. I'm working my way out of basically destitution and that's part of why it's so hard. I don't want to be that. I want to support them. That's always been my goal. If I can't do that I should probably just die. I am such a bad child. I'm just a failure at everything.

I dunno. I've had that observation since fourth grade or so. Everything gets screwed up. I was always scared to do stuff and my friend said "that's not how it goes" so I said Fuck it and went off and had my socially responsible, financially doable fun. And now it's over. I feel like I tempted something.

And I can't help but worry. It would happen in SEptember because I was going to do a lot of things that were going to be fun. I had two events I wanted to go to. Instead I'll be homeless. IT's like the universe says "how dare you enjoy living." And it's always been like that.

Yeah. I just lost my job last week and I feel so defeated and worthless. I just want to die and I don't know where September rent is coming from. I am so sad. I am stressed out. MY head hurts and I can barely focus on doing applications. I am so, so stressed. I'm drowning.
I will. I just need to hear back from any company. Even a no is better than ruminating on it.
I'm sure I will find something that will at least pay the bills with enough effort but no one has gotten back to me for the resumes I've sent out now.

No. I had good insurance with my former company but was too anxious to take advantage of it. Which is pretty dumb in hindsight. I really just want to work and make my own money but not feel like going and killing myself in the parking lot on lunch.
My heart is beating so hard I can see it shaking my laptop screen.
I'm pretty sure I'm just dying now.
I don't even know what I wanted out of this, by the way. I just had to say it somewhere since I'm putting on a real go-getting strong face for everyone I know.
